name: Frost Walker
description:
[term:arcanumbonus][purple]Arcanum Bonuses[/purple][/term]:

  • Grants +[effect:speed][dark-gray]25-50% speed[/dark-gray][/effect] while walking on snow or ice blocks.

  • Permanent freezes nearby powder snow into solid snow.

effects.explanation:
Level I: 25% speed
Level II: 50% speed
